description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Weakness +9% Boost 3]/[Weakness +15% Boost 3]/[Weakness +30% Boost 3] to all allies if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF13 allies are alive, grants [Attach Holy], [Awoken Judgment] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Weakness +9% Boost 3
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 9% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost 3
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost 3
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Judgment
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x3.00 for Holy abilities, casts Divine Sanction after using Holy abilities
